scenes.en_title: Handing a method to a colleague in another role
scenes.zh_caption: 同事已经能生成每日简报，但需要了解的是产品何时可用，原方法却侧重模型能力。交接仍需核对关注范围、来源和交付要求。情境示意。
scenes.en_caption: A colleague can generate the daily brief but needs to know when a product becomes available; the original method emphasizes model capabilities. The handover still needs to address scope, sources and output requirements. Illustrative scenario.

scenes.zh_title: 让修订到达下一位使用者
scenes.en_title: Getting a revision to the next user
scenes.zh_caption: 接收者补上了遗漏的来源链接。如果修改只留在个人副本，下一位同事仍可能拿到旧版。回传之后，还需要核查并更新共享材料。情境示意。
scenes.en_caption: A recipient adds a missing source link. If the change stays in a personal copy, the next colleague may still receive the old version. Returning the revision must be followed by review and an update to shared materials. Illustrative scenario.
